description: A package that keeps the `setTimeout` it finds as it loads, first loaded by a node file, in a project whose environment is `node` with jsdom only through a `@jest-environment` docblock, with one worker. `node-loads` (the largest, so first) loads it; `window-leaves` (a jsdom file) uses it to set a timer that reads `window` and ends before it fires; `waits` (the smallest, so last) waits while it comes due. Jest passes all three: the jsdom file evaluates the package again in its window, so the timer is the window's and `window.close()` cancels it.
